Rossdales Veterinary Surgeons provides independent forward-thinking world-class veterinary services to all sectors of the equine market, along with internationally recognised training and development for the profession. 

We provide our patients and clients with a comprehensive and personal first opinion and referral service, conducted in a caring, ethical and professional manner by our team of over 50 highly qualified veterinary surgeons and more than 100 dedicated support staff.
